title: Umsebenzi noqeqesho
description: Ten short stories about jobs and training: an apprentice builder, a trainee firefighter, a diviner's apprenticeship, a new beekeeper, a motorbike delivery rider, a secretary course, a pilot's first solo flight, a trainee cook at Christmas, a new social worker, and a young policeman on election day.

lessons.title: Umakhi omusha
lessons.summary: School-leaver Mbekezeli trains with old builder Ngcobo in Chatsworth: they knock down an old stone wall, set aside the rusted iron, wheel away soil and stones, and Ngcobo draws the line of a shorter new wall; the boy works hard and is told he will be a real builder next year.
lessons.text:
UMbekezeli uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye. Waqeda isikole nyakenye, kodwa akanawo umsebenzi. Ufuna ukuba ngumakhi. Ubaba wakhe uthi: "Umakhi omuhle akafundi ezincwadini kuphela. Ufunda emsebenzini, eduze nomakhi omdala."

Ngakho uMbekezeli uya kuNgcobo, umakhi omdala waseChatsworth. UNgcobo wakha izindlu iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Uthi: "Ngizokufundisa, kodwa kufanele ukhuthale. Angibagcini isikhathi eside abafana abangakhuthali." UMbekezeli uthi: "Ngizokhuthala, baba."

Ngosuku lokuqala uNgcobo uthi: "Namuhla asakhi. Namuhla siyabhidliza." Ngemuva kwendlu kukhona udonga oludala lwamatshe. Umama ohlala kule ndlu ufuna udonga olusha. UMbekezeli noNgcobo babhidliza udonga oludala ngamandla. Bakhipha amatshe ngamanye. Kuyashisa, futhi uthuli lugcwala yonke indawo. Ukubhidliza kunzima kunokwakha, kodwa uMbekezeli akayeki.

Phakathi nodonga kukhona izinsimbi ezindala. Zigqwalile, zibomvu. UNgcobo uthi: "Bheka lezi zinsimbi. Insimbi egqwalile ayiqinile. Ngeke siyisebenzise odongeni olusha." UMbekezeli ubeka izinsimbi ezigqwalile eceleni.

Ngemuva kwalokho uNgcobo unika uMbekezeli ibhala. Uthi: "Gcwalisa ibhala ngamatshe nangenhlabathi, uhambe nalo uye ngaphandle." UMbekezeli ugcwalisa ibhala. Ibhala lisinda kakhulu, kodwa uyaliqhuba aze afike ngaphandle. Ubuyela, aphinde aligcwalise. Ekupheleni kosuku uMbekezeli ukhiphe inhlabathi namatshe amaningi kakhulu.

Ngosuku lwesibili uNgcobo uthatha induku, adwebe umugqa enhlabathini. Uthi: "Udonga olusha luzohamba lapha, kulandela umugqa." Ngemuva kwalokho udweba udonga ephepheni, abhale ubude balo. Udonga olusha lufishane kunodonga oludala, ngoba lo mama ufuna ingadi enkulu.

Bese uNgcobo uthi: "Manje sidinga isihlabathi." Iloli lifika nesihlabathi esiningi. UMbekezeli ugcwalisa ibhala ngesihlabathi, alihambise lapho uNgcobo exuba khona isihlabathi namanzi. Usebenza ngebhala usuku lonke.

Ngemuva kwamasonto amathathu udonga olusha luphelile. Lufishane, kodwa luqinile futhi luhle. Umama uyajabula. UNgcobo uthi kuMbekezeli: "Ukhuthele kakhulu. Ngithanda abafana abakhuthele. Uma uqhubeka kanje, nyakenye uzobe ungumakhi ngempela."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMbekezeli eya kuNgcobo?
Ngoba ufuna ukuba ngumakhi, futhi uNgcobo ngumakhi omdala ozomfundisa.
Kwenzekani ngosuku lokuqala?
Babhidliza udonga oludala ngemuva kwendlu.
Kungani uNgcobo engafuni ukusebenzisa izinsimbi ezindala?
Ngoba zigqwalile, futhi insimbi egqwalile ayiqinile.
UMbekezeli wenzani ngebhala?
Waligcwalisa ngamatshe, ngenhlabathi nangesihlabathi.
Kungani udonga olusha lufishane?
Ngoba umama ohlala kule ndlu ufuna ingadi enkulu.

lessons.title: Intuthu nomlilo
lessons.summary: Ntombikayise trains as a firefighter in Margate: her instructor Bhekabantu teaches that smoke kills, how to hold the hose and to be careful; at her first house fire a colleague kicks the door open and she crawls under the smoke to bring out a little boy and his cat.
lessons.text:
UNtombikayise uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Ufunda umsebenzi wokucima imililo eMargate. Umqeqeshi wakhe nguBhekabantu, indoda endala esebenze iminyaka eminingi ecima imililo.

Ngosuku lokuqala uBhekabantu uthi kubafundi: "Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi umlilo yiwona obulala abantu. Kodwa ngokuvamile yintuthu ebulalayo. Intuthu iyakhuphuka, ihlale phezulu egumbini. Ngakho uma kukhona intuthu, yehlani phansi, nihambe ngamadolo."

Abafundi bafunda ukuhamba ngamadolo egumbini eligcwele intuthu. Intuthu imnyama, futhi amehlo awaboni lutho phezulu. UNtombikayise akaphefumuli kahle, kodwa uqhubeka.

Ngosuku lwesibili bafunda ngethumbu. Ithumbu lamanzi lide futhi lisinda. Uma amanzi engena ethunjini, ithumbu liyagxuma njengenyoka. UNtombikayise ubamba ithumbu ngamandla. UBhekabantu uthi: "Kuhle. Ungalidedeli ithumbu."

UBhekabantu ubafundisa nokuqaphela. Uthi: "Ukuqaphela kusindisa impilo. Ngaphambi kokuthi uvule umnyango, wuthinte ngesandla. Uma umnyango ushisa, kukhona umlilo omkhulu ngemuva kwawo. Futhi qaphelani amabhodlela kaphethiloli, ngoba umlilo ungawaqhumisa." Uyaphinda: "Ukuqaphela kuqala, isibindi ngemuva."

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu uNtombikayise usebenza nabanye abacimi bomlilo okokuqala. Ngolunye usuku ucingo luyakhala. Indlu iyasha eduze nolwandle. Bafika ngokushesha. Intuthu emnyama iphuma ophahleni. Umama ume ngaphandle, uyakhala: "Maye! Maye! Ncedani! Umfanyana wami usendlini!"

Umnyango uvaliwe. Indoda enkulu esebenza noNtombikayise iwukhahlela umnyango. Iwukhahlela kabili, umnyango uyavuleka. Intuthu iyaphuma. Eduze komnyango kukhona ibhodlela likaphethiloli. UNtombikayise ulithatha alibeke kude, ngoba umlilo ungaliqhumisa.

UNtombikayise ukhumbula izifundo zikaBhekabantu. Wehla phansi, bese engena ngamadolo. Intuthu imnyama phezulu, kodwa phansi uyabona kancane. Ufika egumbini lokulala. Umfanyana uzifihlile ngaphansi kombhede. Ubambe ikati elincane. Uthi: "Angeke ngishiye ikati lami!" UNtombikayise uthi: "Kulungile. Siyahamba sonke." Uthatha umfanyana nekati, aphume ngamadolo.

Ngaphandle umama uyamanga umfanyana wakhe. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokunceda umntwana wami!" Ikati ligijima ngaphansi kwemoto. Abacimi bomlilo bacima umlilo ngamathumbu amabili. Ikhishi lonke lingumlotha manje, kodwa amanye amagumbi awashisanga.

Kusihlwa uBhekabantu uyayizwa le ndaba. Uthi kuNtombikayise: "Wenze kahle. Ukuqaphela kwakho kusindise umfanyana nekati lakhe." UNtombikayise ubheka izandla zakhe. Zimnyama ngomlotha nangentuthu. Uyajabula.

Imibuzo:
Ngokusho kukaBhekabantu, yini ebulala abantu abaningi emlilweni?
Yintuthu, hhayi umlilo kuphela.
Kungani abacimi bomlilo behamba ngamadolo uma kukhona intuthu?
Ngoba intuthu ihlala phezulu egumbini, kodwa phansi bayabona kancane.
Umama ukhala uthini?
Uthi: "Maye! Ncedani! Umfanyana wami usendlini!"
Umnyango uvuleka kanjani?
Indoda enkulu iyawukhahlela kabili.
UNtombikayise uthola bani ngaphansi kombhede?
Uthola umfanyana ophethe ikati elincane.
Kwenzekani ekhishini?
Ikhishi lonke lisha, lingumlotha manje.

lessons.title: Ukuba yisangoma
lessons.summary: Nosithembiso tells how dreams of her late grandmother sent her, with her uncle, to the old diviner Nomacala in Maphumulo: two years of little sleep, bitter medicine, drums, white beads and the customs of the diviners, until she wears the bead headband and the goat skin.
lessons.text:
NginguNosithembiso. Ngakhulela eThekwini, futhi ngangisebenza esitolo esikhulu. Ngonyaka odlule ngagula kakhulu. Ebusuku angilalanga kahle. Ubuthongo abufikanga. Uma ubuthongo bufika, ngaphupha ugogo wami, owashona eminyakeni eyishumi edlule.

Ngolunye usuku ngangilele emini, ngoba ngikhathele. Ngaphupha ugogo wema ngaphambi kwami, egqoke ubuhlalu obumhlophe. Wathi: "Mzukulu wami, kufanele ube yisangoma."

Ngatshela umalume wami, uMfanuzile, lelo phupho. Umalume wami uyayazi kahle inkambo yakudala. Wathi: "Leli phupho alilona elincane. Ugogo wakho uyakubiza. Kufanele uyofunda esangomeni esidala." Ngesaba, kodwa ngavuma.

Umalume wahamba nami saya eMaphumulo, kuNomacala, isangoma esidala esaziwa yibo bonke abantu balapho. UNomacala wangibheka isikhathi eside. Wathi: "Yebo. Amadlozi akho ayakubiza. Uzohlala lapha nami iminyaka emibili." Umalume wabuyela eThekwini, ngasala ngedwa.

Impilo yomfundi wesangoma ayilula. Ngavuka ngaphambi kwelanga nsuku zonke. Ubuthongo babumbalwa. Ngageza emfuleni, ngaqoqa imithi ehlathini. UNomacala wanginika umuthi obabayo, wathi: "Wugwinye wonke." Ngawugwinya, nakuba ubaba kakhulu. Ngemuva kwalokho wathi: "Uma ugwinya umuthi, ungacabangi ngokuthi ubaba. Cabanga ngokuphila."

UNomacala wangifundisa inkambo yezangoma: indlela yokugqoka, indlela yokukhuluma nabantu abagulayo, nendlela yokuhlonipha amadlozi. Wathi: "Isangoma esingayazi inkambo yaso asisona isangoma. Inkambo yethu indala kakhulu."

Kusihlwa izangoma zashaya izigubhu. Isigubhu esikhulu sinezwi elijulile. Ngasina, ngacula, ngize ngikhathale. Ngobunye ubusuku, besilele sonke, ngavuka ngizwa sengathi kukhona oshaya isigubhu kude. Ngalalela. Kwakungekho muntu. Ngakusasa uNomacala wathi: "Lowo kwakungugogo wakho."

Ngemuva konyaka uNomacala wanginika umqhele wobuhlalu obumhlophe. Ngawugqoka ekhanda. Wathi: "Lo mqhele ukhombisa ukuthi ufunde okuningi."

Ekupheleni kweminyaka emibili umalume wabuya nezihlobo zethu. Bahlaba imbuzi. Ngagqoka isikhumba esinoboya bembuzi emahlombe, nomqhele ekhanda. Izigubhu zashaywa, izangoma zasina nami. Ngalolo suku ngaba yisangoma.

Namuhla ngisiza abantu abagulayo eThekwini. Ubuthongo bubuyile. Manje ngilala kahle. Ugogo akafiki njalo emaphusheni ami, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi ulapho. Izolo ebusuku ngangilele kahle, wafika ephusheni lami, wangibheka ejabule.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNosithembiso engalali kahle ebusuku?
Ngoba wagula, futhi waphupha ugogo wakhe.
Ugogo wathini ephusheni?
Wathi uNosithembiso kufanele abe yisangoma.
UNosithembiso wenzani ngomuthi obabayo?
Wawugwinya wonke, nakuba ubaba kakhulu.
Kungani uNomacala ethi isangoma kufanele sazi inkambo yaso?
Ngoba isangoma esingayazi inkambo yaso asisona isangoma.
UNosithembiso wagqokani ngosuku lokugcina?
Wagqoka isikhumba esinoboya bembuzi nomqhele wobuhlalu.

lessons.title: Izinyosi zikaSimiso
lessons.summary: Out of work, Mlondolozi learns beekeeping from his cousin Simiso in Umzimkhulu in spring, when the flowers bloom; he shakes a hive, a bee stings him on the backside, it swells and he sits in the shade, but in two weeks he is no longer afraid and they sell their honey.
lessons.text:
UMlondolozi walahlekelwa umsebenzi wakhe eGoli ngonyaka odlule. Manje ubuyele ekhaya eMzimkhulu. Umzala wakhe, uSimiso, ufuya izinyosi. USimiso unamabhokisi ezinyosi angamashumi amabili. Uthi kuMlondolozi: "Woza uzosebenza nami. Ngizokufundisa ngezinyosi."

Kuyintwasahlobo. Entwasahlobo izimbali ziyaqhakaza yonke indawo: ezihlahleni, emasimini nasezingadini. Uma izimbali ziqhakaza, izinyosi zisebenza kakhulu. Zithatha ukudla ezimbalini, zenze uju. USimiso uthi: "Intwasahlobo yisikhathi esihle kakhulu sezinyosi."

Ngosuku lokuqala uSimiso unika umzala wakhe izingubo ezimhlophe nesigqoko esimboza ubuso. Uthi: "Izinyosi azizithandi izingubo ezimnyama." Bahamba baye emabhokisini. USimiso ubasa umlilo omncane, enze intuthu. Uthi: "Intuthu yenza izinyosi zingathukutheli."

USimiso uvula ibhokisi kancane. Uthi: "Ungalishukumisi ibhokisi. Uma ulishukumisa, izinyosi ziyathukuthela." UMlondolozi uyalalela.

Bese uMlondolozi uvula ibhokisi lesibili. Ubheka phakathi. Kukhona izinyosi eziningi kakhulu! Uyesaba, izandla zakhe ziyanyakaza, alishukumise ibhokisi. Izinyosi ziphuma ngamandla. Inyosi eyodwa ingena ezingubeni zakhe, imhlabe esinqeni. "Hawu!" kusho uMlondolozi. Ugijima, aye emthunzini wesihlahla esikhulu.

USimiso uyafika, ahleke. Uthi: "Hawu, Mlondolozi! Ngithe ungalishukumisi ibhokisi!" Isinqe sikaMlondolozi siyavuvukala. Ubuhlungu bukhulu, akakwazi ukuhlala phansi. USimiso ubeka indwangu emanzi ebandayo lapho kuvuvukala khona.

Bahlala emthunzini isikhathi eside. Emthunzini kuyabanda kancane. USimiso uthi: "Izinyosi zihlaba wonke umuntu ofunda ngazo. Nami izinyosi zangihlaba kaningi. Kodwa ungabaleki. Hamba kancane, ungashukumisi lutho."

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili uMlondolozi akesabi izinyosi. Uvula amabhokisi kancane, angawashukumisi. Uma eshisa, uyaphumula emthunzini. Ekupheleni kwentwasahlobo bakhipha uju oluningi emabhokisini. Bathengisa uju ezitolo zaseMzimkhulu. Abantu bathi lumnandi kakhulu.

USimiso uthi kumzala wakhe: "Ufunda ngokushesha. Nyakenye uzoba namabhokisi akho." UMlondolozi uyahleka, athi: "Yebo, kodwa isinqe sami sizohlala sikhumbula leyo nyosi!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani izinyosi zisebenza kakhulu entwasahlobo?
Ngoba izimbali ziyaqhakaza yonke indawo, futhi izinyosi zithatha ukudla ezimbalini.
USimiso uthi intuthu yenzani?
Intuthu yenza izinyosi zingathukutheli.
Kwenzekani lapho uMlondolozi eshukumisa ibhokisi?
Izinyosi ziphuma ngamandla, inyosi eyodwa imhlaba esinqeni.
UMlondolozi ugijimela kuphi?
Ugijimela emthunzini wesihlahla esikhulu.
Kwenzekani esinqeni sikaMlondolozi?
Siyavuvukala, futhi ubuhlungu bukhulu.
Bathengisa kuphi uju lwabo?
Baluthengisa ezitolo zaseMzimkhulu.

lessons.title: Isithuthuthu esibomvu
lessons.summary: Khanyakude delivers food in Durban on a red motorbike he owes his uncle for; he rides many kilometres in the winter cold, and when two men hijack the bike one night he remembers his trainer's words, does not fight, and the police find the bike the next day.
lessons.text:
UKhanyakude uneminyaka engamashumi amabili nesithupha. Usebenza ngokuletha ukudla kubantu eThekwini. Uhamba ngesithuthuthu esibomvu. Kodwa isithuthuthu asisona esakhe ngempela. Wasithenga ngemali ayiboleka kumalume wakhe. Manje ukweleta umalume wakhe imali eningi. Njalo ekupheleni kwenyanga ukhokha ingxenye yemali ayikweletayo.

Ngaphambi kokuthi aqale umsebenzi, inkampane yamfundisa izinsuku ezimbili. Umqeqeshi wathi: "Gqoka isigqoko njalo. Musa ukushayela ngokushesha emvuleni. Musa ukupaka isithuthuthu emgwaqweni omkhulu. Futhi uma izigebengu zifuna ukuduna isithuthuthu sakho, musa ukulwa nazo. Isithuthuthu singatholakala futhi, kodwa impilo yakho ayitholakali."

Usuku ngalunye uKhanyakude uhamba amakhilomitha amaningi, cishe ikhulu. Ugaxa isikhwama esikhulu ehlombe, agibele isithuthuthu. Uma efika endlini, upaka isithuthuthu eduze komnyango, athathe ukudla esikhwameni. Bese ugaxa isikhwama futhi, ahambe aye endlini elandelayo.

Ebusika kunamakhaza amakhulu ebusuku. Amakhaza angena ezingubeni zakhe, izandla zakhe ziyabanda. Kodwa uyaqhubeka, ngoba ukweleta umalume wakhe, futhi ufuna ukumkhokhela ngokushesha.

Ngolunye ubusuku uletha ukudla endlini ekude, amakhilomitha ayishumi ukusuka edolobheni. Upaka isithuthuthu ngaphandle kwendlu. Uma ebuya, amadoda amabili alinde eduze nesithuthuthu. Omunye uthi: "Sinike ukhiye!" Bafuna ukuduna isithuthuthu.

UKhanyakude uyesaba, kodwa ukhumbula amazwi omqeqeshi: "Musa ukulwa nazo." Unika amadoda ukhiye. Bagibela isithuthuthu, bahambe ngokushesha. Izigebengu zidunile isithuthuthu, kodwa uKhanyakude uphilile.

UKhanyakude uhamba ngezinyawo amakhilomitha amathathu, aze afike emaphoyiseni. Amakhaza makhulu, futhi uyakhathala. Utshela amaphoyisa konke. Ngakusasa amaphoyisa athola isithuthuthu eduze komfula. Izigebengu zibalekile, kodwa isithuthuthu silungile.

UKhanyakude uya ekhaya, axoxele umama wakhe yonke indaba. Umama uthi: "Wenze kahle ngokungalwi nabo." Ngesonto elilandelayo uKhanyakude uya kumalume wakhe, amxoxele indaba naye. Umalume uthi: "Ungakhathazeki kakhulu ngemali okweletayo. Ngiyajabula ukuthi uphilile." NgoMsombuluko uKhanyakude ubuyela emsebenzini ngesithuthuthu sakhe esibomvu.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uKhanyakude ekweleta umalume wakhe?
Ngoba wathenga isithuthuthu ngemali ayiboleka kumalume wakhe.
Umqeqeshi wathini ngezigebengu?
Wathi uma izigebengu zifuna ukuduna isithuthuthu, kufanele angalwi nazo.
Kwenzekani lapho uKhanyakude epaka ngaphandle kwendlu ekude?
Amadoda amabili aduna isithuthuthu sakhe.
Ngubani uKhanyakude amxoxela indaba kuqala?
Uxoxela umama wakhe kuqala, bese exoxela umalume wakhe.
Amaphoyisa athola kuphi isithuthuthu?
Asithola eduze komfula.

lessons.title: Unobhala omusha
lessons.summary: Gugulethu takes a secretary course in Johannesburg with trainer Msomi: she learns to welcome visitors, write short sentences, ask instead of guessing, compare her letter with a good one and improve her English, and she finishes her typing test with seconds to spare.
lessons.text:
UGugulethu ufuna ukuba ngunobhala ehhovisi lenkampane enkulu eGoli. Kodwa kuqala kufanele afunde. Ubhalisa esikoleni sonobhala, lapho ezofunda khona izinyanga eziyisithupha. Umqeqeshi wabo nguMsomi, osebenze njengonobhala iminyaka engamashumi amabili.

Ngosuku lokuqala uMsomi uthi: "Unobhala omuhle wenza izinto eziningi. Uphendula ucingo, ubhala izincwadi, futhi wamukela abantu abafika ehhovisi. Ukungenisa abantu ehhovisi ngomusa kuyinto enkulu. Umuntu ongeniswa kahle uyajabula." Ngalelo sonto abafundi bafunda ukungenisa abantu: ukubabingelela, ukubabuza igama, nokubakhombisa indawo yokuhlala.

Izincwadi eziningi zehhovisi zibhalwa ngesiNgisi. UGugulethu ukhuluma isiZulu kahle kakhulu, kodwa isiNgisi sakhe asisihle. Ugogo wakhe usibiza ngokuthi "yisilungu". Uthi: "Mzukulu wami, uma ufuna umsebenzi wehhovisi, kufanele uqonde isilungu."

UMsomi ubafundisa ukubhala imisho emihle. Uthi: "Bhalani imisho emifishane. Umusho omude kakhulu wenza umuntu ofundayo angaqondi. Umusho ngamunye unombono owodwa." UGugulethu ubhala imisho emifishane, ayifunde kabili.

UMsomi uthi futhi: "Uma ungaliqondisisi igama, ungaqageli. Bheka igama esichazamazwini noma ubuze. Ukuqagela kuyingozi ehhovisi. Unobhala oqagelayo wenza amaphutha amaningi." UGugulethu uyezwa. Manje uma engaliqondisisi igama, akaqageli. Uyabuza.

Ngolunye usuku uMsomi unika abafundi incwadi enhle eyabhalwa ngunobhala onolwazi. Uthi: "Fanisani izincwadi zenu nale ncwadi." UGugulethu ufanisa incwadi yakhe nayo. Ubona amaphutha amaningi, awalungise. Ukufanisa kumsiza ukuthi aqondisise ukuthi incwadi enhle yenziwa kanjani.

UGugulethu ufuna ukuphucula isilungu sakhe. Njalo ebusuku ufunda izincwadi zesiNgisi, abhale imisho emisha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu isilungu sakhe siphuculekile kakhulu. Ugogo wakhe uyamangala.

Ekupheleni kwesifundo kukhona ukuhlolwa. Abafundi kufanele babhale incwadi ngekhompyutha ngemizuzu eyishumi. UGugulethu ubhala ngokushesha. Akafuni ukulahla ngisho umzuzwana owodwa. Ngemizuzwana engamashumi amabili ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi, uqeda incwadi yakhe.

UMsomi ufunda incwadi kaGugulethu. Uthi: "Umsebenzi wakho uyancomeka. Ukhuthele, futhi uphucule isilungu sakho." Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili uGugulethu uthola umsebenzi kanobhala enkampanini enkulu. Incwadi yakhe yokuqala emsebenzini nayo iyancomeka.

Imibuzo:
UGugulethu ufuna ukuba yini?
Ufuna ukuba ngunobhala ehhovisi lenkampane enkulu.
Kungani ugogo kaGugulethu ethi kufanele aqonde isilungu?
Ngoba izincwadi eziningi zehhovisi zibhalwa ngesiNgisi.
UMsomi uthi kufanele wenzeni uma ungaliqondisisi igama?
Uthi ungaqageli, kodwa ubuze.
Ukufanisa incwadi yakhe nencwadi enhle kumsiza kanjani uGugulethu?
Kumsiza ukuthi abone amaphutha akhe, aqondisise ukuthi incwadi enhle yenziwa kanjani.
UMsomi uthini ngomsebenzi kaGugulethu ekugcineni?
Uthi umsebenzi wakhe uyancomeka.

lessons.title: Ibhanoyi phezu kolwandle
lessons.summary: Trainee pilot Phiwokuhle flies alone for the first time in Cape Town, over the waves, Robben Island and the cliffs; when the wind shakes the plane she keeps calm and stays inside the boundary, her trainer Mqondisi congratulates her, and her parents fly in to see her.
lessons.text:
UPhiwokuhle uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Ufunda ukushayela amabhanoyi eKapa. Kusukela eyingane uthanda amabhanoyi. Manje ufunde izinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili. Umqeqeshi wakhe nguMqondisi, indoda endala eshayele amabhanoyi iminyaka eminingi. Namuhla uPhiwokuhle uzondiza yedwa okokuqala.

Ngaphambi kokungena ebhanoyini, uMqondisi uthi: "Ibhanoyi lethu lincane, kodwa umoya walapha unamandla. Uma kukhona inkinga, ungasheshi. Ubuchopho bakho kufanele busebenze kahle. Cabanga kuqala, bese wenza. Indawo yokufunda inomngcele. Ngasentshonalanga umngcele ulwandle ngaphesheya kwesiqhingi. Ungawudluli umngcele."

Ibhanoyi liyaphakama. Ngaphansi kwalo kukhona ulwandle oluhlaza. Amagagasi amhlophe ashaya ogwini. UPhiwokuhle ubona isiqhingi saseRobben phakathi kolwandle. Isiqhingi sincane, futhi amagagasi asizungezile. Ogwini ubona amawa amade. Amagagasi amakhulu ashaya amawa.

Ngemuva kwemizuzu eyishumi umoya onamandla ushukumisa ibhanoyi. Ibhanoyi liyehla kancane. Izandla zikaPhiwokuhle ziyanyakaza. Ukhumbula amazwi kaMqondisi: "Ubuchopho bakho kufanele busebenze kahle." Uphefumula kancane, acabange. Ubamba ibhanoyi kahle, aliphakamise futhi. Ubheka isiqhingi. Akawudlulanga umngcele. Ubuyisa ibhanoyi emuva.

UPhiwokuhle ubuyela endaweni lapho kuhlala khona amabhanoyi. Wehlisa ibhanoyi kahle. Uyaphuma. Kuyashisa kakhulu, futhi womile. UMqondisi umnika amanzi apholile. Amanzi ayamqabula. Uthi: "Lawa manzi angiqabule njengemvula!"

UMqondisi uthi: "Ngiyakuhalalisela, Phiwokuhle! Ngibone umoya ushukumisa ibhanoyi, kodwa ubuchopho bakho busebenze kahle. Futhi awuwudlulanga umngcele." Abanye abafundi nabo bayamhalalisela. Bathi: "Siyakuhalalisela!" UMqondisi uthi: "Ngenyanga elandelayo uzofunda ukushayela ibhanoyi elikhudlwana, elithwala abantu abayisithupha. Ibhanoyi elikhudlwana linzima kancane kunaleli."

Kusihlwa uPhiwokuhle nabazali bakhe bayabonana endaweni yokudla eduze nolwandle. Abazali bakhe bahlala eThekwini, ngakho ababonani njalo. Bafike ngebhanoyi ukuze babonane naye ngalolu suku olukhulu. Umama uyamhalalisela, ubaba uthi: "Ngelinye ilanga uzosishayela ngebhanoyi elikhulu, siye eThekwini."

Imibuzo:
UPhiwokuhle wenzani okokuqala namuhla?
Undiza yedwa ebhanoyini okokuqala.
UMqondisi uthi kufanele enzeni uma kukhona inkinga?
Uthi angasheshi, ubuchopho bakhe kufanele busebenze kahle.
UPhiwokuhle ubonani phakathi kolwandle?
Ubona isiqhingi saseRobben, sizungezwe amagagasi.
Kwenzekani lapho umoya onamandla ushukumisa ibhanoyi?
Uphefumula kancane, acabange, aphakamise ibhanoyi futhi.
Kungani abazali bakaPhiwokuhle beze eKapa?
Beza ukuze babonane naye ngalolu suku olukhulu.

lessons.title: UKhisimusi ekhishini
lessons.summary: Trainee cook Ntombiyenkosi gives up Christmas at home to work in a Ballito hotel kitchen: big pots, a sharp knife and a cut finger, guests dressed up, drinking and dancing, an old man who becomes a fan of her chicken, and the staff dancing together at night.
lessons.text:
UNtombiyenkosi ufunda ukupheka ehhotela elikhulu eBallito. Ungumfundi onyakeni wakhe wokuqala. Umqeqeshi wakhe nguZondi, ophethe ikhishi lehhotela.

Kusondele uKhisimusi. UNtombiyenkosi ufuna ukuya ekhaya eMkhomazi ngoKhisimusi, ukuze abe nomndeni wakhe. Kodwa uZondi uthi: "Umuntu ofuna ukupheka kahle kufanele adele ezinye izinto. NgoKhisimusi ihhotela ligcwele, futhi sonke siyasebenza." Ngakho uNtombiyenkosi udela uKhisimusi wakhe ekhaya. Ushayela umama wakhe ucingo, athi: "Mama, ngiyadela uKhisimusi nonyaka. Ngizofika ngoMsombuluko."

Ngosuku lukaKhisimusi ekuseni kakhulu ekhishini kuyashisa. Izimbiza ezinkulu zisemlilweni. Kwenye imbiza kukhona inyama yenkomo, kwenye inkukhu, kwenye imifino. UNtombiyenkosi ushukumisa ukudla ezimbizeni ngokuqaphela, ukuze kungashi.

UZondi umnika ummese obukhali kakhulu. Uthi: "Qaphela iminwe yakho." UNtombiyenkosi usika inyama nemifino. Usebenza ngokushesha, ngoba abantu abaningi bazofika. Kodwa ummese umsika emunweni. Igazi liyaphuma. Kusala isilonda esincane.

UZondi ugeza isilonda ngamanzi ahlanzekile, asibophe ngendwangu ehlanzekile. Uthi: "Isilonda sincane, sizophola ngokushesha. Kodwa ukudla akumele kuthinte isilonda. Sebenza ngesinye isandla manje." UNtombiyenkosi uyaqhubeka nomsebenzi.

Emini abantu bafika ehhotela behlobile. Abesifazane bagqoke izingubo ezinhle, namadoda ahlobile kakhulu. Bonke bahlobile ngoba nguKhisimusi. Baphuza iwayini notshwala. UZondi uthi kubasebenzi: "Ngeke niphuze lutho oludakayo emsebenzini. Okudakayo kungokwabantu abavakashile kuphela."

Ngemuva kokudla kukhona umculo. Abantu bayadansa phakathi kwamatafula. Indoda endala nenkosikazi yayo badansa isikhathi eside. Kamuva le ndoda iya ekhishini. Ithi: "Ngingumthandi omkhulu wokudla kwaleli hhotela. Ngifika lapha njalo ngoKhisimusi. Ngubani ophekile inkukhu namuhla?" UZondi ukhomba uNtombiyenkosi. Indoda ithi: "Ngiyabonga, ntombazane. Manje ngingumthandi wakho omusha!"

Ebusuku umsebenzi uyaphela. Abasebenzi bahlanza izimbiza, bese badansa ndawonye ekhishini. UZondi uthi: "Ntombiyenkosi, udele uKhisimusi wakho, futhi wasebenza kahle nakuba unesilonda. Ngelinye ilanga uzopheka kahle kakhulu." NgoMsombuluko uNtombiyenkosi uya ekhaya eMkhomazi, ayodla ukudla kukaKhisimusi nomndeni wakhe.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNtombiyenkosi engayi ekhaya ngoKhisimusi?
Ngoba ihhotela ligcwele, futhi uZondi uthi umuntu ofuna ukupheka kahle kufanele adele ezinye izinto.
Kwenzekani lapho uNtombiyenkosi esika inyama?
Uzisika emunweni ngommese obukhali, athole isilonda esincane.
UZondi uthini ngotshwala?
Uthi abasebenzi ngeke baphuze lutho oludakayo emsebenzini.
Indoda endala ithini ekhishini?
Ithi ingumthandi omkhulu wokudla kwalelo hhotela.
Abasebenzi benzani ebusuku?
Bahlanza izimbiza, bese badansa ndawonye ekhishini.

lessons.title: Izintandane zaseNdwedwe
lessons.summary: New social worker Thubelihle visits two orphans in Ndwedwe, a boy and his weak, hungry baby sister: she brings milk and a bottle, teaches the boy to change the baby, listens to his grief, shows that the children are the heirs of their father's house, and brings their grandmother.
lessons.text:
UThubelihle uqede izifundo zakhe zomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle ngonyaka odlule. Manje usebenza eNdwedwe. Umsebenzi wakhe ukusiza izingane nemindeni esenkingeni. Lo msebenzi awulula, kodwa uyawuthanda.

Ngolunye usuku uThubelihle uya endlini encane eduze nesikole. Lapha kuhlala izintandane ezimbili: uMzolisi, oneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha, nentombazane encane, usana olunezinyanga eziyisithupha. Abazali babo bashabalala ngonyaka owodwa. Ubaba washabalala ngenxa yengozi, umama washabalala ngenxa yokugula. Umndeni nomakhelwane babangcwaba eduze nendlu.

Endlini kukhona ubumpofu obukhulu. Akukho kudla okwanele, akukho mali. UMzolisi akayi esikoleni njalo, ngoba unakekela usana. UThubelihle ubona ubumpofu bale ndlu, futhi uyadabuka.

Usana luyakhala. Luncane, futhi lunobuthakathaka. UThubelihle ubona ukuthi aluphuzi ubisi olwanele. Usana luncela umunwe walo, ngoba lulambile. UThubelihle uhamba aye esitolo, abuye nobisi lwezingane nebhodlela. UMzolisi unika usana ibhodlela. Usana luncela ngamandla, luze luqede ubisi. Bese luyathula, luyalala.

Kamuva usana lunyile. Ingubo yalo ingcolile. UMzolisi akazi ukuthi angayishintsha kanjani. UThubelihle uyamfundisa: "Uma usana lunyile, lugeze ngamanzi afudumele, ulufake ingubo ehlanzekile." UMzolisi uyahleka kancane, athi: "Hawu, usana luyanya kakhulu!" UThubelihle uthi: "Wonke umntwana uyanya. Lokho kusho ukuthi uyadla."

Ebusuku uMzolisi ukhuluma ngabazali bakhe ngokudabuka. Uthi: "Ngikhumbula umama nsuku zonke. Ngesinye isikhathi ngiya lapho sabangcwaba khona, ngihlale ngikhulume nabo." UThubelihle uyalalela. Uzwa ukudabuka kwakhe. Uthi: "Ukudabuka kwakho kukhombisa ukuthi uyabathanda kakhulu."

Ngemuva kwesonto umakhelwane uthi kukhona umuntu ofuna ukuthatha indlu yezintandane. UThubelihle uthola amaphepha endlu. Amaphepha athi uMzolisi uyindlalifa yendlu kababa wakhe, nosana naye luyindlalifa. UThubelihle uhamba namaphepha aye ehhovisi likahulumeni. Ihhovisi lithi: "Lezi zingane ziyizindlalifa. Akekho ongathatha le ndlu."

UThubelihle ubiza ugogo wezingane, ohlala kude. Ugogo uyafika, ahlale nabo. Uhulumeni ubanika imali yokudla. Ngemuva kwenyanga usana alunabo ubuthakathaka. Luqinile manje. UMzolisi ubuyela esikoleni nsuku zonke. Uthi kuThubelihle: "Ngiyabonga. Ngelinye ilanga nami ngizosiza izintandane."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMzolisi nosana beyizintandane?
Ngoba abazali babo bashabalala ngonyaka owodwa.
Kungani usana luncela umunwe walo?
Ngoba lunobuthakathaka futhi lulambile, aluphuzi ubisi olwanele.
UThubelihle ufundisa uMzolisi ukwenzani?
Umfundisa ukugeza usana nokulufaka ingubo ehlanzekile uma lunyile.
Amaphepha endlu athini?
Athi uMzolisi nosana bayizindlalifa zendlu kababa wabo.
UThubelihle ubonani endlini?
Ubona ubumpofu obukhulu: akukho kudla okwanele, akukho mali.
Ngubani ozohlala nezingane?
Ugogo wezingane uzohlala nabo.

lessons.title: Usuku lokhetho
lessons.summary: On election day in Kranskop new policeman Khethokuhle and the old officer Hlongwane keep the peace among the voters; two crowds clash, a young man shames an old woman, and instead of reaching for his gun Khethokuhle speaks up, an old man with a shield backs him, and the crowds part.
lessons.text:
UKhethokuhle uneminyaka engamashumi amabili nesithupha. Uqede izinyanga eziyisithupha esikoleni samaphoyisa, futhi manje uqala umsebenzi wakhe wokuqala njengephoyisa. Ngosuku lokhetho amaphoyisa amthumela eKranskop, esikoleni lapho abavoti bezovota khona. Uzosebenza noHlongwane, iphoyisa elidala elinolwazi.

Ekuseni kakhulu abavoti bame ngaphandle kwesikole. Umugqa wabavoti mude kakhulu. Abanye abavoti bafike ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga. Umvoti omdala, ugogo oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili, uhlala phansi eduze nodonga, ngoba imilenze yakhe ibuhlungu.

UHlongwane uthi kuKhethokuhle: "Umsebenzi wethu namuhla ukugcina ukuthula. Wonke umvoti unelungelo lokuvota ngaphandle kokwesaba. Khumbula futhi lokho okufundile esikoleni: ukudubula kuyinto yokugcina. Siyadubula kuphela uma impilo yomuntu isengozini enkulu."

Emini ixuku lifika. Ngabantu beqembu elilodwa. Bacula, bagqoke izingubo ezifanayo. Amanye amadoda aphethe izihlangu nezinduku, njengamaqhawe akudala. Izihlangu zabo zenziwe ngezikhumba zezinkomo. Ixuku liyacula eduze nomugqa wabavoti. Ngemuva kwesikhashana ixuku lesibili liyafika, labantu beqembu elinye. Amaxuku amabili ayabhekana. Ukungqubuzana kuyaqala. Abantu bayaxabana ngezwi eliphezulu.

Insizwa ethile yexuku lokuqala ibona ugogo omdala phakathi kwabavoti. Ithi: "Wena gogo, uzovotela iqembu labo! Uyahlanya!" Imhlaza ngaphambi kwabo bonke abantu. Ugogo uyakhala. UKhethokuhle uyesaba, futhi isandla sakhe sithinta isibhamu sakhe. Kodwa uHlongwane uthi: "Cha! Ukudubula akuyona indlela. Khuluma."

UKhethokuhle uya ensizweni. Uthi: "Musa ukumhlaza lo gogo. Unelungelo lokuvotela noma yiliphi iqembu. Ubudoda abuyona into yokuhlaza abantu abadala. Umuntu onobudoda uyabahlonipha."

Bese indoda endala yexuku lokuqala, ephethe isihlangu, iza kule nsizwa. Ithi: "Doda, nsizwa! Indoda iyabahlonipha abadala. Niyahlanya na? Ningalwi lapha!" Insizwa iyaxolisa kugogo. UHlongwane namanye amaphoyisa athi amaxuku amabili kufanele ahlukane. Ixuku lokuqala liya ngale kwesikole, elesibili liya ngaphesheya komgwaqo. Ukungqubuzana kuyaphela.

Ugogo uyavota, abuyele ekhaya ejabule. Kusihlwa, lapho ukuvota kuphelile, uHlongwane uthi kuKhethokuhle: "Namuhla udodile. Awudubulanga, kodwa ukhulumile. Lokho kudinga ubudoda obukhulu kunokudubula."

Imibuzo:
UHlongwane uthi amaphoyisa kufanele enzeni ngosuku lokhetho?
Uthi kufanele agcine ukuthula, ukuze wonke umvoti avote ngaphandle kokwesaba.
Kwenzekani lapho ixuku lesibili lifika?
Amaxuku amabili ayabhekana, ukungqubuzana kuqale, abantu baxabane.
Insizwa ithini kugogo omdala?
Ithi ugogo uzovotela iqembu labo, futhi uyahlanya.
Kungani uHlongwane ethi uKhethokuhle angadubuli?
Ngoba ukudubula akuyona indlela; amaphoyisa adubula kuphela uma impilo isengozini enkulu.
UHlongwane uthini kuKhethokuhle kusihlwa?
Uthi namuhla udodile, ngoba ukhulumile esikhundleni sokudubula.
